name: Example-Dense-GQA-LlamaStyle
notes: Second dense model description (WP6 generality proof). Dense GQA transformer (Llama/Qwen3-style): RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, no conv/hybrid, no per-head gate. Uses only existing GEMM program shapes where they fit; mismatched shapes reported with padding/constraints (K%64==0, N%1024==0).
constraint_report: qkv projection N = heads*hd + 2*kv_heads*hd = 2048+512+512 = 3072 (multiple of 1024) -> fits plain 2048x3072 program.

FFN intermediate 8192 != 7680: fused FFN kernel constants assume N1=15360 (gate+up, 2*7680) and K2=7680. For I=8192 need N1=16384, K2=8192 (both %1024/%64 ok) but requires rebuilding xclbin/instruction streams with those constants (one xclbin build per model shape set).
No conv layers, no attention gate, no sliding-window mix in this example -> CPU glue path is the dense-GQA subset of the existing runtime.
